name: vscode-ai-search
description: AI Code Search — semantic code search for VS Code / VSCodium. Started from zilliztech/claude-context.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:vscode
scripts.package:vscode: npm run build:core && npm run webpack -w ai-search && npm run package -w ai-search
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ai-search/core && npm run typecheck -w ai-search
scripts.clean: npm run clean -w @ai-search/core && npm run clean -w ai-search
